spec.description: Collector health for the Alloy network fork on this stack: discovery.snmp (job=alloy discovery_snmp_*), SNMP scrape (up + snmp_scrape_*), Alloy-native flow, and Loki alloy-snmptrap / alloy-syslog. Do not use job=integrations/alloy here — that series is a different Alloy.

spec.title: Catalog by group
spec.description: Last successful catalog. group is the discovery job (hq / branch1 / branch2).

spec.title: Probe errors by reason
spec.description: Identity Get failures. timeout/refused on a CIDR sweep is normal; no_auth/no_sys is not.

spec.title: Fingerprint outcome
spec.description: known = matcher hit. unknown = default chain (device_base / if_mib).

spec.title: Discovery logs
spec.description: Alloy stdout: scan complete, catalog add/drop, unknown fingerprint, no_auth/no_sys. Timeouts stay Debug.

spec.title: Scan duration
spec.description: discovery.snmp scan duration. Compare to refresh_interval (lab 5m).

spec.title: Stale (misses > 0)
spec.description: Catalog entries that missed this scan and are approaching drop.

spec.title: Catalog identity
spec.description: Last-good catalog. Join this to up{job=alloy-snmp} when a walk is empty.

spec.expr: max by (device_name, address, group, auth, sysObjectID) (discovery_snmp_device_info{job="alloy"})

spec.title: Unknown fingerprints
spec.description: sysObjectID used the default device_base/if_mib chain in the last hour.

spec.title: Recent syslog
spec.description: Plain-text syslog (protocol=none). severity/facility are labels.

spec.title: Syslog volume
spec.description: Loki {service_name=alloy-syslog}. severity is a label; do not | json.

spec.title: Trap volume
spec.description: Loki {service_name=alloy-snmptrap}. Group by trap_oid — not eventType=KSnmpTrap.

spec.title: Recent traps
spec.description: JSON trap body. Labels include device_name, trap_oid, snmp_group when join hits.

spec.title: Flow throughput
spec.description: Alloy flow is a cumulative Sum. Use rate().

spec.title: Flow series
spec.description: Conversations currently in Mimir from Alloy netflow/sFlow.

spec.title: Flow bytes by device
spec.description: Bytes/s by catalog device_name (sampler join). Empty device_name = unmatched exporter.

spec.title: Discovery catalog
spec.description: Devices in the last successful discovery.snmp catalog (job=alloy). Not the walk.

spec.title: Devices with snmp_CPU
spec.description: Devices exporting snmp_CPU (identity/CPU walk succeeded).

spec.title: Devices down (hot)
spec.description: Hot-tier scrape targets that are down. 0 is healthy.

spec.title: Flow conversations
spec.description: Series count for Alloy-native flow (otelcol.receiver.netflow → signaltometrics).

spec.title: Syslog lines (15m)
spec.description: Loki {service_name=alloy-syslog}. Plain text; severity is a label.

spec.title: Trap lines (15m)
spec.description: Loki {service_name=alloy-snmptrap}.

spec.title: Devices up (hot)
spec.description: Distinct devices with a successful Alloy hot-tier SNMP scrape (60s).

spec.title: Hot scrape up
spec.description: 1 = Alloy reached the device on the hot scrape. job=alloy-snmp.

spec.title: Hot walk duration
spec.description: snmp_exporter walk duration per device (hot tier). Gauge — not rate().

spec.title: PDUs returned (last scrape)
spec.description: SNMP PDUs returned on the last walk. Gauge.

spec.title: Packets retried (last scrape)
spec.description: snmp_exporter last-scrape retry count (gauge, not a counter). Spikes mean timeouts.

spec.title: Scrape targets
spec.description: One row per device × tier (hot 60s / cold 5m). Value 1 = up.

spec.title: Device sysUpTime
spec.description: SNMPv2 sysUpTime (TimeTicks) as seconds. Reboots reset this.

spec.title: Walk duration by module
spec.description: Per-module walk time (if_mib, if_mib_meta, ip_addr, nokia_srlinux_ext, …). Gauge.

spec.title: A1. Alloy Health
